column1: # The pinned native-wire request set (DRY-3). ONE source of truth, read by all
# three consumers so a fixture, a Rust assertion and a TS assertion can never
# drift apart:
#   - `just snapshot-native`  regenerates <name>.json from a live engine
#   - crates/ledgeline-server/tests/native_wire_golden.rs  replays each URI
#   - web/src/lib/api/nativeDecode.test.ts  decodes each <name>.json
# Format: <name>\t<uri>. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
# EVERY date is pinned. fixtures/sample.journal ends 2026-07-04, so 2026-07-08
# is "today" for it — the same as-of the e2e clock and nativeLive.integration.
# test.ts already pin. Nothing here may fall back to the server's system clock,
# or the committed bytes would change tomorrow.
balancesheet
balancesheet-grouped
# The multi-period sheet the Reports tab draws: one column per period end, the
# last at `to`, in the pivoted shape the projection run also returns.
balancesheet-columns
incomestatement
incomestatement-grouped
incomestatement-flows
# Interval mode (plans/24): one column per month plus their Total, no prior.
# `compare=none` is what the SPA sends beside an interval.
incomestatement-grouped-monthly
# The legacy end/count window, still served (plans/24 decision 5).
cashflow
# The from/to window the SPA now sends: first bucket clamped to `from`.
cashflow-range
# Interval = Total: one column spanning the whole range.
cashflow-total
networth
budget
budget-gaps
# The projection SEED only. `POST /api/projections/run` cannot join this
# manifest — it replays URIs, and a run carries its scenario in a request body —
# so that route is pinned by crates/ledgeline-server/tests/projection_endpoints.rs
# instead. `count=12` is the trailing twelve months the unbudgeted averages are
# taken over; there is no `interval`, because a monthly average has only one.
projections-seed
# The ASSET-ROW wire (plans/23-asset-growth.md, Phase 2). The seed reads the
# main journal's `~` rules and sample.journal deliberately has none — two e2e
# specs and the Budget tab's empty state depend on that — so the asset half of
# the scenario wire is pinned by READING ONE FILE instead. It is the only entry
# here with no date in it, and the only one that needs none: nothing in the
# response is derived from a clock. See `every_pinned_request_fixes_its_own_dates`.
projections-asset
insights
subscriptions
holdings
holdings-series
holdings-other
holdings-other-series
